name: reconcile two sources (join, diff, classify discrepancies)

slots.name: EXPLAIN
slots.doc: prompt over one difference {side, id, row, delta}; schema built by the skeleton

when.instructions: Must two record sets that describe the same things be matched and their differences explained?

checklist.text: Timing and FX reasons need the dates and quotes in the judge state.
A duplicate on one side goes to P16 first.

order.source: checklist (L1-PATTERNS §4 P17): 'A duplicate on one side goes to P16 first'; skeleton guard unique-ids (ATTACK-20261014 M4, added 2026-10-14)

slots.MATCH: (L, R) => { const byId = new Map(R.map(b => [b.id, b])); return { matched: L.filter(l => byId.has(l.id)).map(l => ({ left: l, right: byId.get(l.id) })), onlyLeft: L.filter(l => !byId.has(l.id)), onlyRight: R.filter(b => !L.some(l => l.id === b.id)) }; }

EXPLAIN.system: Why do the ledger and the bank differ on this entry? Answer timing, fee, fx or unexplained, with a verbatim quote from the entry that shows it.
EXPLAIN.prompt: (d) => JSON.stringify({ side: d.side, delta: d.delta, entry: d.row })
EXPLAIN.check: (v, d) => v.reason === 'unexplained' || (v.quote && JSON.stringify(d.row).includes(v.quote)) ? null : 'quote not in entry'

slots.ADJUST: (matched, diffs, why) => diffs.map((d, i) => ({ id: d.id, reason: why[i].reason, amountMinor: d.delta }))
